Maize.signs: ragged holes in leaves, sawdust-like droppings in the leaf whorl
organic_remedies: Hand-pick larvae in the early morning
Put dry sand or wood ash into the whorl
Spray neem seed extract on young plants

Maize.signs: yellowing from leaf edges, stunted plants, dead heart
organic_remedies: No cure: uproot and destroy infected plants
Rotate with non-cereal crops such as beans
Use certified clean seed next season

Tomato.signs: brown spots with ring patterns on older leaves
organic_remedies: Rotate crops; copper-based spray from an agrovet only if allowed in organic production, follow the label

Tomato.signs: winding tunnels in leaves, damaged fruit
organic_remedies: Neem or Bt-based products, follow the label

Kale.signs: clusters of small insects under leaves, curled sticky leaves
organic_remedies: Wash off with a strong water spray
Spray soapy water or neem extract

Kale.signs: small holes in leaves, tiny green caterpillars

organic_remedies: Space plants for airflow; use resistant varieties

Beans.signs: seedlings wilt, swelling at the stem base
organic_remedies: Earth up soil around the stem base

Potato.signs: dark water-soaked patches on leaves, white fuzz underneath in damp weather
organic_remedies: Copper-based spray only if allowed, follow the label
Uproot and destroy infected plants (no cure)
Rotate with non-potato crops for 3+ seasons
